title: Told in Time
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (study 90): the 51 signals that eleven public instruments on advanced AI set up, read from their texts and coded by a codebook fixed before any text was opened, one row each on a clock of the latest moment the signal must reach its first reader, shaped by who that reader is, with four squares for whether the text defines what it counts, whether it can move before harm, whether a stranger can read it later and whether its record says a machine or a person acted; each row opens to its quoted passage; beside it this house's own clock, 52 deeds of its machines by the first later commit that took out their lines and by their mending; drawn by script with no library; every quote checked word for word against the texts as fetched (check_quotes90.py), every figure read from the page and recounted by verify90.mjs
embodies: Eleven public instruments on advanced AI (the EU AI Act, the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, Korea's AI Basic Act, California SB 53, China's AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0, the ASEAN Guide on generative AI, the G7 Hiroshima Code of Conduct, the Paris Call of 2026-11-09, New York's RAISE Act, the US BIS rule of 2026-11-19 and the Global Privacy Assembly's resolution on agentic AI; 5 laws, 6 voluntary) set up 51 signals: duties or commitments to record or report something about a model's capability, tests, incidents or compute. First reader: a public body 23, the developer's own record 10, another party 8, the public 10. Of 24 signals in law, 6 reach the public (frameworks, reports at release, lists of names); none of the 9 set off by an event does, 5 only as a yearly anonymised total (California from 2027-01-01, New York from 2028-01-01). Every incident clock with a number runs from the reporter's awareness (5 of 5); the shortest is 24 hours, for imminent danger. 2 signals ask that the record say whether a machine or a person acted (the Privacy Assembly's records of an agent's actions and human interventions; China's logs of system and user activity, in doubt), both voluntary and kept by the operator; 9 more name a machine's own act as a class of incident; none both says who acted and reaches the public. In this house's public Git a later commit took out a line of a deed a median of 2.4 hours after it, but was the deed's mending in only 18 of 52; the mending came a median of 75.6 hours after. Predictions: P146 held, P147 failed, P148 held.
